notes.title: Purpose
notes.text: Seed catalog of beers, ciders, spirits, liqueurs, wines, champagnes, soft drinks, water, energy drinks and juices sold in Cameroonian bars, lounges, hotels and restaurants. Import the 'Catalog' sheet; each row = one sellable SKU.

notes.title: Item name convention
notes.text: [Brand] [Variant] [Volume] [Pack]. Pack is shown only for beer/soft drinks/water where the same product exists in several packs (Bottle, Can, Plastic, Glass, Carton). Examples: 'Castel Beer 650ml Bottle', 'Hennessy VS 700ml', '19 Crimes Red Blend 750ml'.

notes.title: One SKU per size/pack
notes.text: Every volume or packaging is a separate row (different price, cost and stock). 70cl (EU) and 75cl (US) versions of the same spirit are separate SKUs.

notes.title: Packaging codes
notes.text: Bottle = returnable glass bottle (consigne). Glass = one-way glass. Can. Plastic = plastic bottle. Carton = Tetra Brik / juice carton. Served = prepared to order (fresh juice, palm wine).

notes.title: Prices – IMPORTANT
notes.text: All prices are ESTIMATES in XAF per unit, intended as starting defaults only. They were not checked against current price lists. Each outlet must set its own selling price and record real cost from purchase invoices.

notes.title: Est. Cost Price (XAF)
notes.text: The 'source price' – what an outlet typically pays per unit at SABC/UCB depot, wholesaler or cash-and-carry. Local beer and soft-drink prices follow officially homologated (regulated) prices published by the brewers; ask your depot for the current tariff sheet.

notes.title: Ref. Price – Bar / Lounge
notes.text: Two reference selling prices: a standard bar/snack-bar and an upscale lounge/hotel/nightclub. Margin columns are formulas and update when you change cost or price.

notes.title: Sold by Pour/Glass
notes.text: Y = item can be sold by measure. Spirits default to 40ml pour; house-pour wines to 150ml glass. 'Pours per Unit' is a formula (Volume ÷ Pour Size) for stock-depletion tracking.

notes.title: Data Confidence
notes.text: High = brand, spec and availability well established. Medium = sold in Cameroon but pack size / ABV / price should be checked. Verify = plausible but not confirmed; check before activating.

notes.title: Editable cells
notes.text: Cream-shaded cells (cost and prices) are the main values to adjust. Dropdowns on Category, Packaging, Price Tier, Y/N, Sweetness and Confidence keep data clean for import.

notes.title: Barcode (EAN)
notes.text: Left blank intentionally – scan real barcodes at receiving; invented barcodes would corrupt the database.

notes.title: Search aliases
notes.text: Accented names are kept (Mützig, Cîroc, Patrón, D'USSÉ, Ménage à Trois). Configure accent-insensitive search in the app so 'Mutzig', 'Ciroc', 'Dusse' still match.

notes.title: Changes vs previous list
notes.text: Single import table instead of 4 tabs; numeric Volume, ABV and prices (ranges split into separate numeric columns); added SKU code, sub-category, brand, variant, case size, returnable flag, brand owner, wine region/grape/sweetness, cost price, margins, pour data, confidence flag. Corrected 'Johnny Walker' → 'Johnnie Walker'. Unconfirmed items from the old list are flagged 'Verify'.
